## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` in the PetClinic Spring Boot app.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** (`src/main/java/.../rest/controller/v1/`):
- `nextCustomerCode` now takes `city` and `lastName`, producing `CITY3-LAST3-NNNN` — `CITY3` is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, `LAST3` the first three of the last name, and `NNNN` a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
- Added `countOwnersInCity`, which counts existing owners in that city (case-insensitively); the sequence is that count + 1 ("one more than the owners already in that city").
- Updated the call site to pass `owner.getCity()` and refreshed the surrounding comments/javadoc.

**`OwnerMapper.java`** (`mapper/`):
- The `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`) is derived directly from `getCustomerCode()`, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`); I updated its javadoc example to match. No other value is derived from the customer code.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the code matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`, passes — **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.

- `nextCustomerCode` now takes `city` and `lastName`, producing `CITY3-LAST3-NNNN` — `CITY3` is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, `LAST3` the first three of the last name, and `NNNN` a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
- Added `countOwnersInCity`, which counts existing owners in that city (case-insensitively); the sequence is that count + 1 ("one more than the owners already in that city").
- Updated the call site to pass `owner.getCity()` and refreshed the surrounding comments/javadoc.

**`OwnerMapper.java`** (`mapper/`):
- The `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`) is derived directly from `getCustomerCode()`, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`); I updated its javadoc example to match. No other value is derived from the customer code.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the code matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`, passes — **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
